meta.title: Everstead | Your life, organised.
meta.description: Everstead helps UK families securely organise accounts, documents, instructions, and final wishes, with AI that helps you every step of the way. Free to start, no card required.
meta.ogDescription: Everstead is the secure home for your accounts, documents, and important decisions, organised for you today, and ready for your family when it counts.
meta.jsonLdDescription: Secure personal vault for UK families. Organise accounts, documents, and important decisions, accessible today, and ready for your loved ones when it matters.

hero.subtitle: Accounts, documents and final wishes, organised today and ready for the people you love when it matters.
hero.trustpilotAria: Rated Excellent on Trustpilot, read our reviews
hero.imageAlt: A needle-felted family sitting together, looking at a photograph of a grandmother beside an open keepsake box.

why.title: The things families wish they'd sorted. Sorted.
why.intro: When something happens, the people we love spend months chasing details. Everstead puts everything, and everyone, in one calm, secure place.

accounts.title: Every account, found
accounts.desc: Banks, pensions, insurance, subscriptions and digital accounts, listed once so nobody has to go looking.

documents.title: Every document, safe
documents.desc: Wills, LPAs, deeds and policies stored with bank-level encryption, and a record of where the originals live.

people.title: Every person, ready
people.desc: Executors, partners and advisers each get their own view, and clear instructions for the first 48 hours.

current.eyebrow: Up to date, without the chore
current.title: Your plan stays current, quietly.
current.desc: Gentle reminders when documents expire or details go stale. A readiness score shows exactly what's left. Nothing to remember, nothing to chase.
bullets: Expiry reminders for passports, policies and LPAs
A readiness score that shows what's left
Annual check-in, done in ten minutes
current.imageAlt: A quiet monthly summary in Everstead, home insurance renewed, a new ISA added, and a gentle nudge that a passport expires in six months

share.title: The right people see the right things, and nothing more.
share.desc: Give your partner, executor or adviser their own view. You decide what each person can see, and you can change it any time.
bullets: Separate views for partner, executor and adviser
Nothing shared until you say so
Change or revoke access in one tap
share.imageAlt: People & access in Everstead, a partner with full access, a daughter with a single document, and a solicitor sealed until needed

security.title: Protected to the highest standards. Only ever yours.
security.desc: Bank-level encryption, UK data residency and access that you control down to the individual document. We can't read your data, and we never sell it.

pros.title: Your clients, prepared. Your work, faster.
pros.intro: A professional portal that shows what clients choose to share: readiness at a glance, documents to review, and matters that need a nudge.

advisers.title: See the whole picture, not just the portfolio.
advisers.desc: Pension nominations, protection, wills and LPAs, surfaced beside the accounts you already manage, with alerts when they go stale.

solicitors.title: Drafts reviewed, documents requested, matters tracked.
solicitors.desc: A review queue for wills and LPAs, secure document requests straight into the client's vault, and estate-plan and probate progress in one view.

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when your family grows.
pricing.subtitle: Save 20% with yearly billing, all in pounds.

free.name: Everstead
free.desc: Get started and organise the essentials, at no cost, with no card.

family.name: Everstead+
family.desc: For couples and families, two private vaults, one subscription. Organised together, private separately.
features: Each person keeps their own private data

advisor.name: Everstead Pro
advisor.desc: For professionals managing client estate organisation. Pricing on application.
advisor.note: Pricing on application, we're working personally with our first adviser cohort.

pricing.trialNote: Free forever, no card required. Everstead+ includes a 14-day free trial; your card isn't charged until it ends.
